name: Korea, Rep.
headline: Korea, Rep.: +1.1% growth in 2025, 2.1% inflation, debt 52% of GDP
sections: Korea, Rep. is a $1.88 trillion economy (2025), the world's 14th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +1.1% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $63K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 27.4% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 2.1% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 5.1% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 2.8% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 6.7% (2025).
Gross government debt is 52% of GDP (2025), a moderate level that has risen from 46% in 2020. The general government balance is −2.3% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is +6.5% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Trade equals 86% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 0.8% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 50% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 83.6 years (2024). Population: 51.7 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
